verdict.rationale: Gumloop is an automation and agent platform, so white-label embedding is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no white-label or embeddable offering. What it documents are developer building blocks (Python/JS SDKs, an API, webhook triggers) and OAuth for apps whose users sign in with their own Gumloop accounts, which is not white-labeling. None of these deliver an embedded, rebrandable automation experience for a developer's customers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers
